messages:
Anika: quick thread - exploring a compact alert/digest fallback when tenant fanout budget is hit. We want SLOs surfaced in console but avoid 100 pings during a noisy window.
Ravi: Are we talking about on-incident fanout or config-change notifications?
Anika: Both, but primary focus on incident-driven SLO alerts. Config-change emails are separate.
Beck: Proposed flow: keep existing notify flow, track per-tenant `fanout_budget` (tokens per minute). If an event would exceed budget -> enqueue into a 10-min digest.
Jo: What's the digest format? We need it actionable (links to incident, severity, top affected routes).
Beck: Sketch: title, 3x bullet SLOs with short description, direct link to console incident, TTL for digest (expires after 15m). Include small stacktrace link if available.
Ravi: Telemetry: emit `slo.notify.fanout_mode` (values: immediate, condensed, blocked) and `slo.notify.digest_count`. Rollout: sample telemetry at 100% for 72h for early tenants.
Anika: UI: show a tiny badge on SLO settings: "Fanout policy: condensed when budget low" with preview button to list who would get pings now.
Jo: API change note: `POST /api/v1/notify-preview` should return `fanout_mode` and `budget_remaining` so console preview matches runtime. Backwards compatible.
Beck: Also need a safety: if condensed digest would drop critical severity (P0) for >2 tenants, bypass budget and still immediate fanout. We should define bypass heuristics.
Ravi: Suggestion: bypass if severity >= P0 or if `affected_tenants > 3` and SLA breach confidence > 80%. Needs a signal `slo.impact.confidence`.
Anika: Rollouts: enable condensed fallback for 1% tenants for a week, check `slo.notify.effective_count` and `slo.alert.latency` for regressions. If any tenant shows >30% increase in time-to-ack, abort.
Jo: Tests: unit for budget math, integration for preview endpoint, e2e sim that generates 200 quick alerts to see digest behaviour.
rollout-bot: rollout started: condensed-fanout-v1 -> 1% (tenants selected) (ok).
Beck: Quota sizing: default budget = 200 tokens / hour. Each immediate ping = 1 token, digest = 5 tokens. Configurable per-enterprise.
Ravi: Ops alert: create alert if `slo.notify.fanout_mode == condensed` exceeds 10% of production tenants for >30m. We might be silently under-notifying.
Anika: Agree. Also add a manual override in console per-tenant to opt out of condensed mode.
Jo: UX copy: "Condensed mode reduces noisy pings by grouping alerts. In emergencies (P0) we still fast-path alerts."
Beck: I'll open PR for API preview change + proto, add telemetry counters and tests.
Anika: Thanks team. Sync tomorrow 10am to review telemetry output. :rocket:
